verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad public developer API at developer.brex.com, covering Accounting, Budgets, Team, Expenses, Payments, Transactions, Travel, Onboarding and Webhooks. It also offers a quickstart for making a first API call, Postman support, and an llms.txt index, which makes it drivable programmatically by AI-native users. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a standard path (all probed openapi/swagger paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Check out our quickstart guide to get up and running making your first Brex API call in just a few minutes.
Payments API: Manage vendors and send ACH, domestic wires, and checks
Team API: Manage users, locations, departments, and cards
Expenses API: View and manage card expenses data, receipt match and receipt uploads
APIs to build on top of the Brex financial OS.
